title: Singular limit of lattice graphs and its application to critical Lane--Emden equations on lattice graphs
summary: In this paper, we establish new connections between lattice graphs and metric grids, providing a unified framework for the study of singular limit problems and Gagliardo--Nirenberg type inequalities on lattice graphs. The main technical ingredients are restriction and extension estimates, which enable us to compare variational problems posed on lattice graphs, metric grids and \(\mathbb R^d\).
